spec.hypothesis: Moving a constant reference to attention23 avoids changing intermediate queries/keys and exposes only MLP23 to its RMS effect. Reuse one existing shared value coordinate with the smallest measured native output contribution.
spec.coordinate_rule: Minimum mean squared norm of the sum of all seven sharing-head output contributions, on196 earlier factual states plus4405 native states. Compute with the seven-column O Gram matrix and observed attention values.
spec.reference_rule: Lowest eigenvector of trace-normalized incoming23, original native final residual, and effective decoder second moments, orthogonal to the existing twelve-dimensional semantic carrier.
spec.amplitude_rule: Sixteen times the maximum absolute incoming23 projection on the196+4405 construction states.
spec.attention_change: Set one V row to zero and its bias to one. Project O off the reference direction, zero its seven sharing output columns, and write amplitude*reference through the first sharing head.
spec.fixed_RMS_compensation_formula: Multiply both protected last-MLP input matrices by median(new_RMS/old_RMS) on the1352 earlier native external positions. Compare this one analytically specified factor with no compensation; no amplitude or gain search.
